Name: Comet Wasp
Information:
**Comet Wasp**

The comet wasp is a space insect that feeds on any scraps of minerals and organic tissue it can find. It has an astoundingly long life span, able to live for up to 200 years. They are ravenous meat-eaters who dissolve their targets from the inside out using acid contained in their stinger, then consume the produced soup-like sludge. This can include minerals in space or the organic tissue in their prey.

actions.name: Sting
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. The target must succeed a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) acid damage and be poisoned for 1 minute. A creature who succeeds this save becomes immune to being poisoned by a comet wasp’s sting for 1 hour.

actions.name: Drain
actions.description: The wasp makes a Sting attack against a poisoned target. If it hits it does not provoke the saving throw or its effects, but the wasp drains away melted organic material from the target and gains the damage its Sting does as temporary hit points.
